translations.web: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
translations.bsb: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.
translations.kjv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
translations.asv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having seven plagues, which are the last, for in them is finished the wrath of God.
